_note: A hand calculation of the example (a made-up owner's company; example assumptions, not facts), checked against the confirmed facts in shared/facts.json by tests/model.test.mjs. The top 2026 rate on a non-eligible dividend, per $1 of dividend: federal (1 + 0.15) x 0.33 - 0.15 x 9/13 = 0.3795 - 0.1038462 = 0.2756538; Ontario (1 + 0.15) x 0.1316 x (1 + 0.20 + 0.36) - 0.15 x 0.22895 = 0.2360904 - 0.0343425 = 0.2017479 (the Ontario credit comes off after the surtax, Taxation Act 2007 16(2)); together 0.4774017. Income tax is rounded once, to the dollar: 200,000 x 0.4774017 = 95,480.35, so $95,480; 1,000,000 x 0.4774017 = 477,401.7, so $477,402.
